# v0.8.0b1 — Vehicle profiles and optional automatic charging permission

Beta of the integration and app. **0.6.1 remains stable.**

Changes compared with stable 0.6.1:

- **Vehicle profiles:** keep each car's sources, optional targets, departure
  settings and charging-loss averages together. BavarianData can supply
  supported vehicle data from one selection; manual HA sources still work.
- **Optional automatic selection:** recognize a profile from its cable and home
  signals, with conservative handling of unclear or unavailable data.
- **Optional Virtual Plug & Charge:** allow a recognized, permitted profile to
  receive charging release. It is off by default, requires fresh connection
  evidence and preserves pauses, locks and reached targets. This is a convenience
  feature, not ISO 15118 or cryptographic vehicle identification.
- **Live Modbus debugging:** the app can temporarily show decoded reads, writes,
  heartbeats and failed responses. Capture is off by default, held in memory and
  automatically erased; it creates no additional Recorder history.
- **Clearer setup:** focused feature menus, better descriptions, optional
  supported Waveshare setup/TCP login and guided app setup on
  **Supervisor 2026.10.4+**.
- **Reliability:** stronger handling of delayed commands, interrupted saves,
  heartbeat recovery, vehicle changes and optional data-source failures.

Keep your existing HA entry and app data. In service mode, update the app to
**0.8.0b1 through #apps-beta first**, wait for initialization, then update the
integration. The new app supplies Virtual Plug & Charge and live debugging.
Ordinary service connections still support **API 2 and service 0.6.1 or newer**;
direct USB/LAN needs no app. **#apps stays on stable 0.6.1.** Switching app
catalogs requires a controlled handover; never run two owners on the same bus.
